hp: Turns Indian Sign Language into speech, signs your words back, and teaches ISL — all on your device.
d_s2v: Camera reads your signs and speaks them aloud.
d_v2s: Type or speak — the avatar signs for you.
d_quiz: Watch a sign, guess the meaning.
out_sub: updates live next to the camera
idle_cam: Show a sign to the camera…
ph_pred: show a sign to the camera
words_sub: type or speak — the avatar signs instantly
av_idle: Type or speak to see signs…
av_note: Words not in the sign dictionary are skipped or fingerspelled.
fs_hint: Tap a letter to see the handshape.
q_watch: Watch the sign… what does it mean?
t_nomic: Speech recognition is not supported here — please type.
t_novoice: No voice for this language on this device — showing text only.
t_unknown: Some words are not in the sign dictionary.
hint_g: Watch the avatar slowly and copy the movement.
org_t: For hospitals, banks, stations and schools
org_d: A two-way service desk: staff speak or type, the customer signs. Organisations are verified before they get access.
know_d: Short multiple-choice quizzes. Your scores are saved to your account.
need_login: Please log in as a learner to open Learn and Quiz.
a_wait: We check the registration number before your desk is switched on.
d_ready: Camera ready. Video stays in your browser; only hand points are sent.
d_dataset: Use signs recorded from the dataset
